title: LLMLL v0.6 JSON-AST Schema
description: A JSON representation of the LLMLL Abstract Syntax Tree. Every .llmll source file must correspond to a JSON object validated against the top-level 'Program' definition. This schema is the machine-checked interface between AI code-generators and the LLMLL compiler pipeline.

Program.description: Top-level structure. A file is a flat list of statements (no implicit root module). Wrap in a module statement if namespacing is desired.

schemaVersion.description: Must be '0.6.0'. The compiler rejects files with an unrecognised version. v0.6.0 is the canonical version for v0.11 .ast.json files; kind:"def" and kind:"def-shell" nodes are the standard forms under --grammar=core-inversion (now the default). LT-INV §8 gate confirmed EL-5 2026-05-30; grammar default flipped to GrammarCoreInversion.

llmll_version.description: Compiler version that emitted this file. Informational only — the compiler does not validate this field.

Statement.description: A top-level definition. Corresponds to EBNF 'statement'.

DefCore.description: A strict-core function with optional pre/post contracts. Corresponds to EBNF 'def'. Kind must be exactly 'def'. Body is restricted to the core-body whitelist (ELit, EVar, QF-LIA EOp, ELet with PVar, EIf under path-limit, EApp to body-faithful or trusted-prelude callees, EMatch on Result 2-arm, ?hole/?name/?choose/?request-cap/?scaffold/?delegate/?delegate-async). Excluded: lambda, letrec, do-notation, ?proof-required, non-linear arithmetic, opaque crypto, untrusted FFI. Self-recursion is excluded — use def-shell for recursive functions. Return type is always inferred — omit it. Under GrammarCoreInversion (default since v0.11), this is the standard form for high-assurance functions eligible for body-faithful SMT verification. LT-INV v0.11.

pre.description: Precondition. Must be bool-typed. Absence means 'true'.

post.description: Postcondition. Must be bool-typed. 'result' is in scope here only.

spec_entropy.description: Optional contract discriminative-power annotation (LT-CDP v0.11). 'strict' = maximally constraining spec; 'intentional' = intentionally loose to allow diverse implementations; 'unknown' = not yet classified. Absent means the compiler applies heuristic classification.

DefShell.description: A permissive-shell function with optional pre/post contracts. Corresponds to EBNF 'def-shell'. Kind must be exactly 'def-shell'. Admits the full body language: lambda, self-recursive calls, wasi.* capability calls, do-notation, ?proof-required, and arbitrary user-function calls. Verified at the contract tier (pre/post contract-only proof) rather than body-faithful SMT. Use for recursive algorithms, effectful computations, and any body form excluded from the strict-core whitelist. Return type is always inferred — omit it. LT-INV v0.11.

pre.description: Precondition. Must be bool-typed. Absence means 'true'.

post.description: Postcondition. Must be bool-typed. 'result' is in scope here only.

spec_entropy.description: Optional contract discriminative-power annotation (LT-CDP v0.11). Same semantics as on DefCore.

DefInterface.description: A named interface (contract boundary). Corresponds to EBNF 'def-interface'.

IfaceMethod.description: One method slot in a def-interface.

DefInvariant.description: A module-level invariant. Stored and type-checked in v0.2; LiquidHaskell verification is Phase 2b.

TypeDecl.description: A user-defined type: either a refinement type alias (where) or a sum type (ADT). Corresponds to EBNF 'type-decl'.

oneOf.description: Sum type / ADT: list of (| Constructor payload) arms

Variant.description: One arm of a sum type. Omit 'payload' for nullary constructors.

GenDecl.description: A custom value generator for a refinement type alias. Used by the PBT engine. Corresponds to EBNF 'gen-decl'.

type_name.description: The refinement type alias this generator produces values for.

body.description: Expression yielding a value of the base type satisfying the dependent constraint.

CheckDecl.description: A property-based test. Must contain exactly one for-all. Corresponds to EBNF 'check'. OBLIG-PBT-4 (v0.10.6): optional 'subjects' array carries explicit ':subject f' / ':subjects [f g …]' keyword metadata; absent or empty omission keeps the v0.10.5 head-position-scan semantics at the PBT writeback site.

subjects.description: Optional explicit-subject opt-in (OBLIG-PBT-4). Each entry is a contracted function name receiving its own DLTested record on the property's pass; all entries share the same pbt_witnesses hash. Must contain ≥1 entry when present (S6); duplicates are deduped (S7).

ForAll.description: The single for-all body inside a check block.

ImportDecl.description: Capability or FFI import. In v0.2+, the compiler resolves user-module paths to source files. Built-in prefixes (wasi.*, haskell.*, c.*) are handled by the codegen preamble — no file lookup occurs. Use the 'hub.' prefix for registry packages.

interface.description: For FFI imports: the typed interface the foreign library exposes.

ModuleDecl.description: An optional namespace wrapper. The module name is for documentation and tooling display only; the canonical module path is derived from the file's location relative to the source root (see LLMLL.md §8.1). Body is flattened during compilation.

TypedParam.description: A named, typed parameter. Pair-type in 'param_type' is supported since v0.2.

untyped.description: Legacy field — no longer needed since v0.2. Pair-type in param_type is fully supported.

comment.description: When untyped=true, document the expected type here.

Type.description: Any LLMLL type expression. Corresponds to EBNF 'type'.

TypeFn.description: A function type. Named params are documentation-only; both 'typed' and bare type arrays are valid.

TypeWhere.description: A refinement type alias: (where [binding: base] predicate).

TypePair.description: A 2-tuple product type: (a, b). v0.3 PR 1: now backed by TPair internally (distinct from Result in diagnostics and JSON-AST output).

TypeCommand.description: The opaque Command type. Cannot be pattern-matched.

TypeNamed.description: A user-defined type referenced by name, e.g. 'Word', 'PositiveInt', 'GameState'.

value.description: String content. RFC 8259 JSON escaping applies: use \uXXXX for non-ASCII and control characters (e.g. \u001b for ESC, \n for newline). C-style \xNN is not valid JSON and will cause a parse error.

ExprVar.description: A variable reference. 'result' is only valid inside a post clause.

ExprLet.description: Sequential let bindings (let*). Each binding is in scope for all subsequent bindings and the body.

ExprIf.description: Conditional: (if cond then else). All three branches are required.

ExprMatch.description: Pattern match. MUST be exhaustive — include a catch-all arm ("_") if needed.

Pattern.description: A match pattern. Corresponds to EBNF 'pattern'.

oneOf.description: Literal equality: match a specific value.

ExprApp.description: A plain function call: (fn-name arg1 arg2 ...). Use for user-defined def/def-shell and built-in stdlib functions.

fn.description: Name of the function. No dots. Use qual-app for qualified calls.

ExprQualApp.description: A qualified capability call: (wasi.io.stdout ...). Use for command constructors.

qual_fn.description: Dot-separated qualified name with at least one dot, e.g. 'wasi.io.stdout'.

ExprOp.description: A built-in operator: +, -, *, /, =, !=, <, >, <=, >=, and, or, not, mod.

args.description: Unary ops (not) take 1 arg. All others take exactly 2.

ExprAwait.description: Await a Promise[t]: (await promise-expr). The expression's inferred type is Result[t, DelegationError], not bare t. The generated code wraps Async.wait in exception handling so agent failures are captured as Result.Error rather than propagating as uncaught exceptions. Breaking change from v0.2 where await returned bare t.

ExprDo.description: Monadic do-notation: a sequence of bound steps and plain expressions.

DoStep.description: A single step in a do-block (PR 2: unified form). Named steps bind the state component; anonymous steps discard it (state-loss hazard if non-terminal). Old kinds 'bind-step' and 'expr-step' are rejected with a migration error pointing to 'do-step'.

name.description: If present, bound to the state component of expr's result (former bind-step). If absent, the state component is discarded (former expr-step).

state_type.description: Optional hint: the state type S. Required only when expr itself is a hole.

ExprLitList.description: List literal: [a, b, c]. Desugared by the parser to nested list-prepend calls.

ExprHole.description: A typed hole. Can be named, a choice, a capability request, a scaffold, or a delegation.

oneOf.description: ?request-cap(path) — request a new capability from the operator.
?scaffold — cold-start a module from a known template.
?delegate — blocking delegation to a named agent.

agent.description: Bare agent identifier (without the surface `@` sigil). The `@` is S-expression surface syntax; in JSON-AST the bare name is stored. Example: 'crypto-agent', not '@crypto-agent'. See LLMLL.md §11.2.

oneOf.description: ?delegate-async — non-blocking delegation. return_type is the INNER type T; the compiler wraps it in Promise[T]. Do not write Promise[T] as return_type. A top-level Promise wrapper is stripped as legacy; nested Promise wrappers are rejected at parse time.

agent.description: Bare agent identifier (without the surface `@` sigil). The `@` is S-expression surface syntax; in JSON-AST the bare name is stored. Example: 'crypto-agent', not '@crypto-agent'. See LLMLL.md §11.2.

return_type.description: The inner type T. The compiler wraps this in Promise[T] automatically. A top-level Promise wrapper is stripped as legacy compatibility; nested Promise wrappers are rejected.

oneOf.description: ?proof-required — Phase 2b. Emitted by the compiler for pre/post constraints outside the QF linear arithmetic fragment, or for letrec :decreases measures that are not simple variables. Also valid as a manual annotation. Non-blocking: code compiles with a runtime assertion fallback. Two forms: (1) bare leaf — no 'predicate' field; marks the clause asserted, no active runtime assertion at codegen. (2) predicate-carrying (LT-PPR, v0.11) — optional 'predicate' field present; compiler type-checks it as bool and emits a Haskell runtime assertion (if pred then () else error ...) in pre/post position; non-linear predicates emit a QF-LIA warning at llmll check. Body-position ?proof-required is unchanged. See LLMLL.md §6 and getting-started.md §4.11.

reason.description: Why this hole was emitted. 'manual' = authored by agent; others = compiler-emitted.

predicate.description: LT-PPR (v0.11): optional predicate expression for the predicate-carrying form. Valid in pre/post position only. When present, type-checked as bool; emits a runtime assertion at codegen. Absent for the bare-leaf form.

OpenDecl.description: Pull a module's exports into the current scope without a prefix. NEW in v0.2. Corresponds to EBNF 'open-decl' (LLMLL.md §8.6).

path.description: Dot-separated module path to open, e.g. 'app.auth'.

names.description: Selective open: only these names are brought into scope. Omit to open all exports.

ExportDecl.description: Restrict the names exported by this module to those listed. NEW in v0.2. If absent, all top-level defs are exported. Corresponds to EBNF 'export-decl' (LLMLL.md §8.7).

names.description: Names of def, def-shell, type, def-interface, or gen declarations to export. check and def-invariant are never exported.

DefMain.description: Declares the program entry point and runtime harness. Corresponds to EBNF 'def-main' (§9.5 LLMLL.md). Without a def-main the compiler generates a library only. At most one def-main per program.

init.description: Expression returning (State, Command) pair. Executed once at startup. Optional — if absent the initial state is ().

step.description: Function or expression of type (State, String) -> (State, Command). Called on each input line (console) or OS args (cli).

read.description: Custom input reader expression (optional, console only).

done?.description: Predicate of type State -> Bool. When true the console loop exits (optional).

on-done.description: Function of type State -> Command called once when done? returns true (optional).

PatchEnvelope.description: LLMLL patch request envelope (v0.3). Submitted to 'llmll patch' CLI or POST /patch HTTP endpoint. Not part of the AST schema proper — companion definition for agent tooling.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations to apply to the JSON-AST.

PatchOp.description: A single RFC 6902 JSON-Patch operation (v0.3). Supported ops: replace, add, remove, test. 'move' and 'copy' are deferred to a future release.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer targeting a node within the checked-out subtree.

value.description: The value to use for replace/add/test. Required for replace, add, test. Must be absent for remove.

CheckoutToken.description: Checkout token response from 'llmll checkout' or POST /checkout (v0.3; context-aware v0.3.5). Companion definition for agent tooling.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the checked-out hole. Normalized: leading zeros in numeric segments are stripped (EC-3).

token.description: 32-character hex bearer token. Include in patch requests.

ttl.description: Lock time-to-live in seconds. Default: 3600 (1 hour).

in_scope.description: v0.3.5: Bindings visible at the hole site (Γ delta). Sorted by source priority; may be truncated.

expected_return_type.description: v0.3.5: Inferred return type at the hole site (τ as LLMLL type label).

available_functions.description: v0.3.5: Non-wasi.* function signatures (Σ), monomorphized against concrete scope types.

type_definitions.description: v0.3.5: User-defined type aliases and sum types referenced by in-scope bindings. Depth-bounded expansion (max 5 levels) with cycle detection.

recursive.description: True if cycle detected during alias expansion (EC-4).

scope_truncated.description: v0.3.5: True if in_scope was truncated to the 50-entry limit (C6).

TrustDecl.description: Trust acknowledgment for an imported function's unproven contract (v0.3, §4.4.3). Silences TrustGapWarning diagnostics. Must appear before any def or def-shell function declaration. Multiple trust declarations per module are allowed; duplicates are idempotent.

level.description: The verification level being acknowledged. Sample counts for 'tested' are compiler-internal (stored in sidecar .verified.json, not in surface syntax).

WeaknessOkDecl.description: Suppression governance declaration. Silences --spec-coverage 'unspecified' warnings for a named function. Both 'name' and 'reason' are required; an empty reason is rejected by the parser (LLMLL.md §4.5). Corresponds to EBNF '(weakness-ok fn-name "reason")'. v0.6.

name.description: Name of the function to suppress weakness warnings for.

reason.description: Mandatory non-empty reason for the suppression.

examples.name: render-board
examples.reason: pure string rendering — no meaningful postcondition
